name: Blood & Blood Derivatives
aliases: blood, animal blood, blood powder, dried blood, blood plasma, plasma protein, blood plasma protein, haemoglobin, hemoglobin, haemoglobin powder, hemoglobin powder, blood protein, porcine blood, bovine blood
what_is: Food ingredients made from animal blood or separated blood fractions, including plasma and blood proteins such as haemoglobin.
why_botia: BOTIA flags explicit blood-derived terms because Codex CXG 24-1997 lists blood among sources considered unlawful for use of a halal claim. BOTIA detects declared ingredient terms; it does not certify halal status.
can_1: Identify explicit blood, blood plasma, haemoglobin and related blood-derived terms when they are declared on the label.
can_2: Trigger the Muslim and animal-origin information layers for a declared blood-derived ingredient.
cannot_1: Determine the animal species when a generic term such as blood, plasma or haemoglobin is used without a stated source.
cannot_2: Certify or guarantee that a product is halal, or verify slaughter, collection, processing, cross-contact or certification controls.
